name: dealpme
description: DealPME : place de marché de transmission et reprise de PME (zone OHADA, pilote Togo). Monorepo TypeScript.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w packages/domain -w packages/contracts -w packages/i18n -w packages/testing -w packages/notifications -w codebases/engine/rules -w codebases/external_connectors -w codebases/frontend/ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w codebases/engine/rps -w codebases/backend/api -w codebases/backend/worker -w codebases/frontend/web -w codebases/devtools/sms-inbox -w codebases/devtools/registry-mock -w codebases/devtools/event-simulator
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:apps
scripts.infra:up: npm run build -w packages/notifications -w codebases/external_connectors/registry -w codebases/external_connectors/remo -w codebases/devtools/sms-inbox -w codebases/devtools/registry-mock -w codebases/devtools/event-simulator && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile local up -d --build
